# CSARC Repo Template

> A reviewable, updatable repository foundation for work definition, verification, and governed delivery. / 可審查、可更新且可離線交付的 repository 公版，涵蓋工作定義、驗證與發布治理。

## Work and review / 工作與審查

- [Issue / Issue 工作單](https://github.com/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/blob/main/AGENTS.md#working-loop): A unit of work that defines one observable outcome, its scope, and acceptance criteria. / 界定一個可驗收結果、範圍與完成條件的工作單位。
- [Story Milestone / 故事里程碑](https://github.com/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/blob/main/docs/milestone-description.md): An independently verifiable multi-Issue story, created only for an end-to-end outcome. / 只有端到端成果需要時才建立、可獨立驗證的多 Issue story。
- [Pull request / Pull request](https://github.com/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/blob/main/.github/pull_request_template.md): The integration boundary that preserves intent, verification evidence, and human review. / 保存變更意圖、驗證證據與人類審查的整合邊界。
- [Decision record / 決策記錄](https://github.com/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/blob/main/docs/adr/README.md): The durable record of confirmed architecture, tooling, security, and compatibility trade-offs. / 保存已確認的架構、工具、安全與相容性取捨。

## Verification and capability / 驗證與能力

- [Fast checks / 快速驗證](https://github.com/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/blob/main/docs/ci-policy.md): Short feedback checks selected by change risk; they do not replace full pre-delivery verification. / 依變更風險執行的短回饋檢查，不取代交付前完整驗證。
- [Full verification / 完整驗證](https://github.com/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/blob/main/AGENTS.md#commands): The repository-wide pre-delivery contract for code, policy, and artifacts. / 交付前執行的 repository 級契約，統一檢查程式、政策與產物。
- [Platform capability state / 平台能力狀態](https://github.com/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/blob/main/docs/adr/portable-decision-site.md): Observed capability recorded as allowed, blocked, or unknown instead of inferred from plan names. / 以 allowed、blocked 或 unknown 記錄實測能力，不從方案名稱猜測。
- [DEGRADED governance / DEGRADED（能力降級）](https://github.com/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/blob/main/README.md#設定與密鑰): A GitHub plan or permission cannot enforce a control; the template retains the desired policy and requires a human fallback without reporting an unrun control as passed. / GitHub 方案或權限不支援某項強制功能；公版保留期望政策並要求人工補足，不把未執行誤寫成通過。
- [Governance exception / 治理例外](https://github.com/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/blob/main/docs/index.html#governance): A time-bounded fallback that records its proposer, a different approver, expiry, evidence, and recovery path. / 有期限的替代做法，必須記錄提出者、另一位核准者、到期日、證據與恢復方式。
- [Portable artifact / 可攜式產物](https://github.com/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/blob/main/docs/adr/portable-decision-site.md): A single-file deliverable with no external runtime assets that remains usable through file://. / 沒有 runtime 外部資產、可下載並以 file:// 離線使用的單檔交付物。

## Integration and delivery / 整合與交付

- [Delivery branch / Delivery branch](https://github.com/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/blob/main/docs/ci-policy.md): The branch where independent PRs for one story integrate before promotion reaches main. / 讓同一 story 的獨立 PR 先整合，再由 promotion 進入 main 的分支。
- [Promotion / Promotion](https://github.com/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/blob/main/docs/ci-policy.md): The explicit delivery action that advances a verified delivery branch to main. / 把已驗證的 delivery branch 提升到 main 的明確交付動作。
- [SemVer intent / SemVer 意圖](https://github.com/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/blob/main/docs/ci-policy.md): Declared by a validated PR title to express compatibility impact; it does not allocate an exact version. / 由已驗證的 PR 標題宣告相容性影響；它不會自行配置精確版本。
- [Version materialization / 正式版本配置](https://github.com/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/blob/main/docs/adr/release-security-and-dependencies.md): Synchronizing version files, package metadata, the changelog, and the README marker in one reviewed change. / 在同一張受審查變更中同步版本檔、套件 metadata、CHANGELOG 與 README marker。
- [Release / 發版](https://github.com/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/blob/main/docs/adr/release-security-and-dependencies.md): Publishing a version with an immutable tag, GitHub Release, explicit artifacts, and verifiable evidence. / 以不可變 tag、GitHub Release、明列成品與可驗證證據發布一個版本。
- [Delivery / 交付](https://github.com/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/blob/main/docs/adr/release-security-and-dependencies.md): Moving reviewed and verified work into the authoritative branch or to users; it does not always create a version. / 把受審查且已驗證的工作送進權威分支或交給使用者；不一定產生新版本。
- [Deployment / 部署](https://github.com/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/blob/main/docs/adr/release-security-and-dependencies.md): Operating the product in a real runtime with health checks, approval, and recovery; outside the template's current scope. / 把產品送入真實 runtime environment，並負責健康檢查、核准與復原；不在本模板現行範圍。
- [Artifact evidence / 成品證據](https://github.com/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/blob/main/docs/adr/release-security-and-dependencies.md): Binding artifact checksums, the SBOM, source commit, build identity, and any required attestation. / 把成品 checksum、SBOM、來源 commit、build identity 與必要 attestation 綁在一起。
- [Copier update / Copier 更新](https://github.com/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/blob/main/README.md): A reviewable template update that preserves project-owned content in an existing repository. / 以可審查差異把公版變更套入既有 repository，保留專案持有內容。
